NCLT Halts Subhash Chandra Repayment Plan, Seeks CBI Response

The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has put Subhash Chandra's repayment plan on hold and requested a response from the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) within four weeks. The tribunal stated that the CBI's investigation into the Zee founder's case could impact the proceedings concerning his ₹6.5 crore repayment plan.
